Fixes #784

Router removes supported geolocation headers and structured search/retrieval location fields from routed HTTP and JSON WebSocket requests by default. Exactly one `x-router-share-geolocation: true` header permits sharing for that request or connection; Router consumes it. Account overrides cannot restore stripped metadata. Prompt content, user tool schemas and search availability retain their behavior.

Reproduce by routing a supported location header or structured search location without consent. Both complete 259-case native runtime suites pass in the latest local gate attempt, covering removal, valid/invalid/duplicate consent, overrides, fragmented WebSockets and all eight mixed Gemini spellings. Matching Rust regression source remains unrun until every mandatory JavaScript stage passes for the same SHA. Changelog fragments prepare the existing release process.

This is an authorized **incomplete draft CI feedback checkpoint**, `a598d2b01b5a8e47bbf6bb5a8f90b317d90ce5de`. All original assertions, whole files, deadlines, strict TypeScript settings, compiler bounds and mandatory CI stages remain required. No new executable production-function gain or controlled speed gain is claimed.

The coordinated repairs:

- Compose the actual class-birth/receiver and project-progress source successors while retaining every complete historical source, independent original pin, CST phase and inverse.
- Privately associate the genuine enclosing parser and complete method analyses within one captured project input. Actual Display methods retain their independent source/owner checks; foreign analyses, copies, proxies and mutations remain refused.
- Share at most 1024 positive scalar size measurements through one existing operation. Every whole-graph eligibility check and logical debit remains mandatory; records are weakly keyed and cleared before original callbacks and operation exit.
- Losslessly compress the entire static source bank below the existing 4 MiB per-file export bound. Every decoded byte and both actual producer source equations remain checked.
- Refresh the complete isolated compiler registry from source commit `8c35fb19f95697e0c6c9459930d83ec4153f3ee8`: 1934 real source files, complete prior registration history and the genuine 493-object portable Git fixture. No admission bound is increased.
- Retain the preceding published head's entire terminal failure set, all 25 complete original artifact ZIPs, 23 available full nonpassing job logs and the complete available workflow ZIP. Verified retirement of this task's inactive published duplicates preserves their immutable whole Git objects and keeps current evidence below 500 MB.

The preceding [run 42832857700](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/actions/runs/42832857700), published head `79f375ed1d9690ab8336e06a28331c2871092eb0`, tested merge `ac46abf2eb6c7f311287bfdaa8a7dabe834f34fa`, is terminal: all 59 jobs finished, including 24 nonpassing jobs. Translation shard eight exceeded its original one-hour job limit; its job log is unavailable through both job APIs and the complete workflow ZIP. Metadata and the check annotation survive; no unobserved test result is inferred. [Complete terminal review and custody](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/case-studies/issue-784/ci-79f-terminal-20261110.md).

Focused checks use Node 20.20.2, Bun 1.4.4 and lockfile TypeScript 5.9.3; CI's Bun 1.4.3 is a separate receiving environment:

- Class-birth history: both complete files pass, 23 cases per engine; Node's independent deadline audit passes.
- Project progress history: both complete files pass, ten cases per engine; Node's independent deadline audit passes.
- Operation size measurements: three complete files pass, 15 cases per engine; both Node audits pass. A bounded whole-production diagnostic remains explicitly unqualified.
- Display context: seven complete Node files pass all 43 cases and their deadlines. The same Bun cohort passes 36 cases and fails seven unchanged default deadlines.
- Static archive: all 20 Node assertions pass, including actual complete compiler export, but the independent audit fails two original deadlines: 163665.85/60000 ms for both complete producers and 62052.67/60000 ms for complete storage. Bun is unrun.
- Isolated registration: both complete receiving files pass all 16 cases in each engine. Node's independent audit has zero errors, missing cases or deadline breaches.

The **complete local gate at `619e356569fdafd369d9f1fad41766f86041d59c` failed**. All ten lint commands, both 259-case runtime suites, deadline controls, both package type checks, native freshness and strict 167-file native TypeScript compilation passed. The cgroup guard interrupted the complete native TypeScript regression file after four passing assertions. All remaining TypeScript commands, parity, forward and reverse checks were unrun. Every owned process was collected; no green stamp exists. The subsequent checkpoint contains documentation/evidence only; the complete gate is **unrun at the checkpoint SHA**. [Complete gate evidence](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/case-studies/issue-784/current-619e-complete-gate.md).

Remaining mandatory work includes all original deadlines, the Schemars candidate regression's stale composition expectation, private compiler closure reduction within its separate 4 MiB raw bound, canonical/normal/owned and profile matrix generation, strict TypeScript counterparts, CSV/ActivityPub behavior, genuine generated-output freshness, strict parity and the complete same-SHA gate. Current CI matrices reach their original 60-minute limits; TypeScript then lacks the genuine owned-matrix JSON. Strict parity retains 441 draft gaps and 12431 carried items. The previous canonical artifact executes 162/2578 production top-level functions; it does not establish current-tree freshness or parity. Complete local production generation still exhausts its recorded heap/resource limits. These are code/resource failures, with no identified missing secret or human-only setup action. No check is skipped or weakened, and no Rust tool ran locally. Collect this checkpoint's entire CI cycle before the next coordinated push.

Latest `main`, `eb2dad1c0a18394dc1aad46413e11401e74eb502`, is already an ancestor without conflicts. The complete issue and every feedback endpoint were refreshed: no required sub-issues, issue comments, inline comments or reviews; all seven conversation comments are read. GitHub rejects the complete PR diff above 300 files; the coordinated source changes were reviewed locally and `git diff --check` passes. Historical evidence records an earlier temporary storage-cap overrun; the latest complete evidence count is below 500 MB.

Universal client/account privacy remains unmet: source-IP observation, provider account/security inference, direct telemetry/OAuth/MCP traffic and unsupported private client/subscription paths cannot be certified by Router's metadata filter. No authorized vendor account/session was supplied for dashboard changes. The [case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/case-studies/issue-784/README.md), [configuration guide](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/docs/privacy/geolocation.md) and [current checklist](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-784-1f6838f56841/experiments/issue-784/current-9b6-repair-plan.md) preserve every requirement and limit. Keep this PR draft and unmerged until every acceptance criterion and same-SHA check passes.
